channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Jury convicts Duane 'Keffe D' Davis of first-degree murder for the 1996 killing of rap icon Tupac Shakur
item.description: A jury found Duane “Keffe D” Davis guilty of orchestrating the 1996 killing of rap icon Tupac Shakur, marking the first conviction in a case that has gripped hip-hop fans for decades.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US military has no plans to send troops to the polls in November, top general says
item.description: The highest-ranking officer in the U.S. military says there are no plans to send troops to polling places during November’s midterm congressional elections.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Friend of Utah father struck by lightning while jet skiing near Egmont Key describes final moments
item.description: A man visiting Florida from Utah died Saturday after being struck by lightning while riding a jet ski.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa Bay Rays stadium: Work on temporary college campus could start soon
item.description: It's full steam ahead for the Tampa Bay Rays and supporters of the stadium deal, with the expectation that work at the site could begin soon.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Anna Maria Island considering a paid, permitted parking system
item.description: Anna Maria Island is considering instituting a paid or permitted parking system to try and combat the increase in tourism to the area.
